content_html:
9th November 2026

Anthropic released Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2 today. I've added them to 

llm-anthropic
, so you can now run prompts through Fable 5.2 like this:

uv tool install llm
llm install llm-anthropic
llm keys set anthropic
# paste key here
llm -m claude-fable-5.2 "Generate an SVG of a pelican riding a bicycle"

I ran pelicans at all five reasoning levels - 

low
, 
medium
, 
high
, 
xhigh
, and 
max
. You can see them all here - here's the best result I got, from 
xhigh
:

max
failed to return an image at all, running out of tokens after spending 128,000 thinking about them. That's the same bug that I saw with Opus 5.5 - but it's new for the Fable series, both Fable 5 and Fable 5.1 returned max effort pelicans just fine.
